verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents a Bayesian statistics engine behind its experiments ('Decision making with Bayesian statistics'), including how it declares a winning variation versus highlighting a leading one when data is insufficient. Experimentation, including warehouse-native runs on Snowflake, is a documented product feature. The pack has no evidence of variance-reduction options such as CUPED, and no frequentist option, so only the core engine half of the story is substantiated. Missing for 10: documented variance-reduction options (e.g., CUPED/covariate adjustment), a frequentist or sequential method choice, independent or hands-on corroboration of the stats engine's rigor.
